name: Redfin-scraper
what_it_holds: Generic 'scrape housing market data' tool targeting Redfin; last updated Dec 2024, unclear which fields/geography it covers.
why_useful: Marginal — undocumented scope; only useful as a fallback method if redfin-market-pulse doesn't cover needed fields.
duplicate_of_holding: redfin-market-pulse covers similar ground with clearer scope
themes: Long-term rent indices: Zillow ZORI/ZHVI downloaders, Apartment List, Redfin data center, Realtor.com, HUD Fair Market Rents, Census ACS rent, CoStar-like

name: post_covid_rent_analysis
what_it_holds: Analysis of U.S. county-level rent trends before/after COVID-19 using Zillow ZORI data, focused on geographic and temporal patterns in housing costs.
why_useful: Likely carries a committed county-level ZORI time series spanning pre/post-2020, useful as a ready county panel rather than re-downloading from Zillow directly.
themes: Long-term rent indices: Zillow ZORI/ZHVI downloaders, Apartment List, Redfin data center, Realtor.com, HUD Fair Market Rents, Census ACS rent, CoStar-like
Housing affordability and STR-housing studies data: rent-burden, vacancy, STR share of housing stock by tract
why_all: Likely carries a committed county-level ZORI time series spanning pre/post-2020, useful as a ready county panel rather than re-downloading from Zillow directly.

County-level ZORI pre/post-COVID time series construction; a minor building block for a rent-cost baseline panel relevant to STR-vs-LTR host economics, but thin and MIT-licensed with no unique new data beyond raw ZORI.

name: Rental-Planner
what_it_holds: XGBoost model predicting 12-month rent trends by ZIP code, trained on Zillow ZORI and HUD Small Area Fair Market Rate (SAFMR) data; produces YoY rent-change forecasts and seasonality profiles by ZIP.
why_useful: ZIP-level ZORI granularity is finer than county; if the raw ZIP panel is committed it's a useful finer-grained rent series.
themes: Long-term rent indices: Zillow ZORI/ZHVI downloaders, Apartment List, Redfin data center, Realtor.com, HUD Fair Market Rents, Census ACS rent, CoStar-like
Housing affordability and STR-housing studies data: rent-burden, vacancy, STR share of housing stock by tract
why_all: ZIP-level ZORI granularity is finer than county; if the raw ZIP panel is committed it's a useful finer-grained rent series.

ZIP-level SAFMR + ZORI join with a seasonality decomposition is a usable pattern for a fine-grained (ZIP-level, finer than metro) long-term-rent baseline, useful context for STR-conversion economics (gap #13), though it is a forecasting tool, not a static dataset.

name: zillow_market_analysis
what_it_holds: Clustering of housing markets based on Zillow's ZHVI (home value) and ZORI (rent) data, combining both series. Pushed 9 Dec 2024.
why_useful: Joint ZHVI+ZORI file, if committed, gives both price and rent series in one place for a market-clustering cut — modest incremental value over pulling Zillow's own CSVs.
themes: Long-term rent indices: Zillow ZORI/ZHVI downloaders, Apartment List, Redfin data center, Realtor.com, HUD Fair Market Rents, Census ACS rent, CoStar-like
why_all: Joint ZHVI+ZORI file, if committed, gives both price and rent series in one place for a market-clustering cut — modest incremental value over pulling Zillow's own CSVs.

name: US_Census_Building_Permits
what_it_holds: Web-scraped US Census Bureau building permits data with Python scripts producing Tableau visualizations. Last updated 2021.
why_useful: Building permits proxy new housing (and indirectly new STR-eligible) supply, named explicitly in gap 13; stale but shows the acquisition pattern for Census permit series.
